items:
Come share our beach cottage and make some beautiful vacation memories with your friends and family. A short coastal stroll from the silky sugar sand of Inlet Beach and only minutes from Seaside and Rosemary Beach. Enjoy restful sleep in the spacious master suite and gather downstairs in the large open space for food and fun. Enjoy morning coffee and evening cookouts in the ocean air on the back deck. Located on the eastern edge of 30A only minutes away from premier shopping and restaurants.

Are you coming for a special event let me know so I can assist in customizing your stay for the vacation you will never forget with little extra effort (because you are on vacation, right?)
Here are a few ideas or questions that could guide the customization process:
1. Birthday: options for birthday decorations, cake delivery, or special dinner arrangements at one of our local restaurants?
2. Anniversary: Romantic amenities such as champagne, flower arrangements, or a private dinner setup?
3. Girls' Weekend: group activities or local spa options I could recommend and set up? Perhaps a welcome basket tailored for the group?
4. Special Requests: we are open to helping with any personalized requests guests might have to enhance their stay?
These offerings could truly elevate your guest experience.

1.we can also assist in fires at the Beach (we would need a permit) - we have preferred vendors

2. Babysitters if needed ( at of course an additional expense)
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
